g.text: kickoff checklist: clean tree, feature branch
official review: red (a file it named is missing)
build: the plan, the last report
red: the failures, word for word
review: the request and the change
Solid: an objective handed over. Dashed: a match report handed back. Red: a correction, in the same session.
Every step above is a row in match_log.db the moment it happens, so ogsf var and Matchday Live show it live.
